verdict.rationale: Grok's own docs describe built-in, xAI-maintained OAuth connectors for Google Drive (search, read, manage files) and Gmail (search with Gmail operators). The overview says connected tools let Grok reach your email, files, and calendar inside a chat. Missing for 10: calendar-specific search and use capabilities are not detailed beyond the overview mention and the Gmail/Calendar connector page name, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the connectors working.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can connect my cloud drive, email, and calendar so the assistant can search and use them in answers

citations.quote: Connect your tools so Grok can reach your email, files, and calendar right inside a chat.
Each one authenticates via OAuth, so you connect once and Grok can access your data on demand.
The Google Drive connector lets Grok search, read, and manage files in your Google Drive.
Search emails using Gmail search operators
